beat: The key survived the fire. Marrow kept your sibling debt and your name. The young Mechanic opens the shop with shaking hands.
The engine turns over at last. A race receipt buys a part. Every payment leaves another question in the ledger.
Scree hides yesterday under fresh stone. The Mechanic patches your tires before dawn. A bare frame waits behind his parts counter.
Relay offers work without a signature. Deliveries pay better when nobody asks what is inside. You can refuse and still keep racing.
Rook once owed this same garage. He calls the debt a lesson. His hands shake when Marrow is mentioned.
A scorched receipt survives behind a tool rack. Part of your payment never reached the debt. Marrow calls the missing money a handling charge.
Rook blocks the road out of the Yards. Win this race and he will promote your name. Cash or a car or a fitted part: you choose.
Rook has put his name beside yours. Ox races to keep his foundry crew employed. The Mechanic follows with a truck full of parts.
A lender offers an advance with a fixed fee. The ledger makes the price plain. The safer climb needs no signature.
Ox gives no ground on a straight. His heavy car needs room to turn. The crew watches every brake light.
Your sibling used a false name at Ridge Wire. Mica recognizes the handwriting on the entry form. She pockets the page before you can ask why.
Crew wages appear as penalties in the debt book. Your diverted payments bought Marrow private fleet. Ox brings the receipts that can prove it.
Relay finds a chassis with an honest serial plate. Trading the old car leaves its parts behind. Choose what the next field demands.
Ox lays duplicate receipts on your bonnet. Beat him and his crew will stand behind you. The diverted money goes back on your account.
Ox has forced the collector to correct the books. Future payments now reach the debt in full. Vex knows where the missing driver went.
A shelter holds a glove from your garage. The stitching is fresh. Your sibling survived the fire.
Someone switched the ammunition in a sealed crate. The Mechanic catches it before you leave the shop. He keeps the empty dispatcher for his bare frame.
Vex saw a car leave after the last official race. Its driver carried a copy of Marrow books. He will tell you where for a clean contest.
An official result omits an entire lap. The payment still lists a full race. The same account number appears again.
Relay admits moving sealed ledgers for the league. One delivery went north instead of to Marrow. Mica arranged the change.
Vex has kept the northbound address safe. Win and he will carry your name to the next division. His promotion comes as cash or a car or a part.
Cold air reaches the engine before dawn. Mica waits above the last town. The Mechanic has hidden your sibling in his workshop.
The duplicate debts paid for Marrow private fleet. A wreck became a new fee on the next page. Your garage burned when the copies disappeared.
Your sibling calls from the safe workshop. The Mechanic was afraid to tell you until now. He stayed because someone had to keep a door open.
Mica divides the evidence among the crews. One lost race can no longer erase it. The mountain still demands an exact line.
A rival carries a grudge into the next grid. The passing gets sharper. The car obeys the same rules as before.
Marrow offers to clear only your family debt. The Mechanic turns down a price for your location. Mica sends the private deal back unsigned.
Mica divides the evidence among the crews. Beat her and she will promote the driver carrying it. No single wreck can burn every copy now.
Marrow opens his own speedway to the circuit. The crews arrive with copies of the ledger. The cameras now belong to everyone.
The league drivers bring the cars they could afford. Victories paid for their parts. Wrecks cost them the same way they cost you.
Relay reads the duplicate entries over the pit radio. Ox confirms where your payments went. Even a cleared balance cannot satisfy Marrow.
The Mechanic fits the mine dispatcher in his rig. A plain engine. A rough seat. A real chance. He does not ask you to trust another secret.
Vex gives every crew an unedited race recording. Marrow has run out of numbers to hide behind. He starts talking about ownership instead.
Marrow demands your car as collateral after this race. The Mechanic rolls his bare rig out of the shop. One more result before the debt becomes a death fight.
Marrow seizes your car under a fabricated lien. The Mechanic gives you his rig and mine dispatcher. No lap victory. Last car running ends his reign.
